title: Phase 7 (Minimal): Basic global error toasts (top-right, gold border, pearl text, 4s fade)

requirements.summary: Add a minimal reusable error-toast helper that renders a top-right toast with gold border, pearl text (#F5F5F0), and auto-dismiss/fade after ~4 seconds using an English default message format.
acceptanceCriteria: Triggering the helper displays a toast in the top-right corner (existing Toaster placement is preserved).
Toast text color is exactly #F5F5F0 and the toast has a gold border.
Toast fades out and is fully dismissed after ~4 seconds.

file_operations.description: Create a minimal reusable helper (e.g., showBasicErrorToast) built on the existing toast infrastructure (sonner) to display a top-right error toast with a gold border, pearl off-white text color #F5F5F0, and 4s auto-dismiss with fade; include a default message like "Error: Please try again".
Add a small, scoped CSS class/animation to support a ~4s fade-out behavior for the basic error toast without altering existing theme tokens, hover effects, or layout.

requirements.summary: Wire the basic error toast into existing error paths for OTP send/verify, invalid OTP, Internet Identity login failures, and dashboard profile save failures without changing routing/auth flow/UI layout.
acceptanceCriteria: Entering a wrong OTP triggers the error toast.
Forcing a profile save failure (e.g., actor/network failure) triggers the error toast.
Existing pages (login/dashboard/admin/storefront) remain visually stable with no layout shifts introduced by the change.

file_operations.description: Import and invoke the new basic error toast helper on: invalid OTP entry, OTP send failures, OTP verify failures, and Internet Identity login failures—while preserving existing OTP/II logic, routing behavior, and current UI structure.
Invoke the new basic error toast helper when profile save fails (including network/actor errors) while keeping the current dashboard layout, animations, and save flow intact.

requirements.summary: Keep the change minimal and non-invasive: no notification UI, no rate limiting, no heavy logic; preserve current theme/hover/layout; do not change SPA routing or authentication flow.
acceptanceCriteria: No new notification/bell UI is present anywhere.
Navigation/routing behavior remains identical to the current reverted working version.

file_operations.description: Ensure the helper remains lightweight (single utility, no new UI surfaces) and does not introduce rate-limiting/throttling logic or any routing/auth changes.
Confirm wiring only adds toast calls in existing error branches (no new flows, routes, or layout changes) and does not introduce new notification UI elements.
Confirm changes are limited to error handling (toast invocation) without altering layout, animations, or navigation behavior.

requirements.summary: Add a deployment verification checklist artifact to record the draft URL and confirm: no blank screen on login, error toast visible when triggered, and UI stability.
acceptanceCriteria: A draft URL is provided after deployment.
Confirmation explicitly states: no blank screen on login; toast visible on wrong OTP and failed save; UI stable.

file_operations.description: Add a short Phase 7 verification checklist section including fields/placeholders for the draft URL and explicit confirmation items: (1) no blank screen on login, (2) error toast visible on wrong OTP and failed save, (3) UI stable.

Extend the storefront login verification checklist to include validating the new top-right basic error toast on wrong OTP and Internet Identity login failure cases, without changing the existing login flow documentation structure.
